rules.R01: Standardise state labels to the canonical list of 36 states + FCT; drop the 'National' row (kept only for reconciliation).
rules.R02: Parse numbers as printed (strip thousands separators, % signs, footnote asterisks); values marked '?' by the extraction are treated as unreliable and set to missing.
rules.R03: Arithmetic identity checks (male+female=total, public+private=total, qualified<=all teachers, pop-enrolment=out-of-school); mismatches beyond rounding are flagged and the affected component set to missing.
rules.R04: Exact duplicate rows across different states (or public==private within a state) cannot be trusted: BOTH copies are set to missing.
rules.R05: Printed percentages/ratios are recomputed from counts; printed values are used only for reconciliation.
rules.R06: Plausibility bounds: enrolment ratio labelled 'net' cannot exceed 100%; average pupils per school must lie in [20, 3000]; enrolment/child-population above 150% is implausible.
rules.R07: Cross-table and cross-year reconciliation (Table 2.8 vs 2.10/2.11 vs 2015/16): inconsistencies are flagged (non-critical) unless a hard rule above applies.
rules.R08: Column-level acceptance: a column whose values fail a necessary consistency test for more than 20% of rows, or carries uncertainty markers, is rejected entirely.
rules.R09: Robust outlier screening (median/MAD, |z|>3.5 on the log scale for ratios) - flagged, never silently removed.
